variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
